label: Wadjet system
definition: A quality in which an organism possesses a Wadjet locus encoding JetABCD, MksBEFG, EptABCD, or related SMC-family components that restrict circular plasmids through ATPase-dependent DNA cleavage.
observations: Wadjet branch under quality; distinct from individual jet, mks, or ept genes, JetABCD or MksBEFG protein-complex activities, source database rows naming one predicted Wadjet locus, topology-sensing or DNA-cleavage subactivities, other plasmid-defense systems, plasmid carriage, plasmid-borne anti-restriction systems, CRISPR-Cas, restriction-modification, and dedicated phage-defense system families.
